# opencode-freepi Free Pi provider connector for [opencode](https://opencode.ai) — use Free Pi's free unlimited AI models directly in your terminal. ## What's included | File | Purpose | |------|---------| | `plugins/freepi-session.ts` | Pins all Free Pi traffic to one session (avoids 4-session cap) | | `scripts/freepi-ads.py` | Background ad impressions so free tier stays active | | `config/opencode.example.json` | Example opencode config with Free Pi provider | | `install.sh` | One-command installer for any Linux distro | | `uninstall.sh` | Clean removal | ## Free unlimited models - `particle` — Particle - `deepseek-v4.1-flash` — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (reasoning) - `glm-5.3-flash` — GLM 5.3 Flash (reasoning) Other models consume credits from your daily allowance (20,000/day, refills 00:00 UTC). ## Prerequisites - **Linux** (any distro with bash) - **Python 3.8+** - **opencode** — [install guide](https://opencode.ai/docs/) - **Node.js** (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun) — for free-pi-cli and plugin deps ### Installing prerequisites per distro
Debian / Ubuntu / Mint ```bash sudo apt update sudo apt install -y python3 curl git # Node.js (via NodeSource LTS) curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | sudo -E bash - sudo apt install -y nodejs ```
Fedora / RHEL / CentOS Stream ```bash sudo dnf install -y python3 curl git nodejs ```
Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS ```bash sudo pacman -S --needed python curl git nodejs npm ```
openSUSE Leap / Tumbleweed ```bash sudo zypper install -y python3 curl git nodejs npm ```
Alpine ```bash sudo apk add python3 curl git nodejs npm ```
NixOS ```bash # Add to environment.systemPackages in configuration.nix: # python3 curl git nodejs sudo nixos-rebuild switch ```
Void Linux ```bash sudo xbps-install -S python3 curl git nodejs ```
Gentoo ```bash sudo emerge dev-lang/python net-misc/curl dev-vcs/git nodejs ```
opencode itself ```bash # One-liner (any distro) curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash # Or via npm npm install -g opencode-ai ```
## Installation ```bash git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/opencode-freepi.git cd opencode-freepi chmod +x install.sh uninstall.sh ./install.sh ``` The installer will: 1. Install `free-pi-cli` if missing (via your package manager) 2. Run `free-pi login` and save your API key to `~/.config/opencode/freepi.key` 3. Copy the session-pinning plugin to `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` 4. Copy the ad impression script to `~/.config/opencode/scripts/` 5. Merge the Free Pi provider into your existing `opencode.json` (non-destructive) 6. Install plugin npm dependencies 7. Set up a systemd user service for background ad impressions **Restart opencode** after installation. ## Verify it works ```bash # Check your Free Pi account (should show remaining credits) curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.config/opencode/freepi.key)" \ https://api.freepi.ai/me | python3 -m json.tool # Check the ad service is running systemctl --user status freepi-ads # In opencode, pick a free model: # /model freepi/deepseek-v4.1-flash ``` ## Manual installation If you prefer not to use `install.sh`: 1. **Login to Free Pi:** ```bash npm install -g free-pi-cli free-pi login ``` 2. **Save your API key:** ```bash TOKEN=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$HOME/.free-pi/agent/credentials.json'))['token'])") mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode echo -n "$TOKEN" > ~/.config/opencode/freepi.key chmod 600 ~/.config/opencode/freepi.key ``` 3. **Copy files:** ```bash mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/{plugins,scripts} cp plugins/freepi-session.ts ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ cp scripts/freepi-ads.py ~/.config/opencode/scripts/ chmod +x ~/.config/opencode/scripts/freepi-ads.py ``` 4. **Merge config:** Add the `freepi` provider block and plugin path from `config/opencode.example.json` into your `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`. 5. **Install plugin deps:** ```bash cd ~/.config/opencode && npm init -y && npm install ``` 6. **Run ad impressions** (background): ```bash python3 ~/.config/opencode/scripts/freepi-ads.py & ``` ## Configuration The key setting in `opencode.json` is the session header, which the plugin handles automatically: ```json "headers": { "x-session-id": "opencode-freepi", "x-client-version": "0.6.11" } ``` Free Pi allows **4 concurrent sessions** per account. The plugin pins all opencode traffic to a single session ID so you never trip the cap. ## Troubleshooting | Problem | Fix | |---------|-----| | `429` or session errors | Ensure `freepi-session.ts` is in your `plugins` array and opencode was restarted | | Ad service not running | `systemctl --user start freepi-ads` or run `python3 ~/.config/opencode/scripts/freepi-ads.py &` | | `401 Unauthorized` | Token expired. Re-run `free-pi login` and re-copy the key | | Plugin not loading | Check `npm install` ran in `~/.config/opencode/` | | Model not found | Ensure `freepi` provider block exists in `opencode.json` | Check credits anytime: ```bash curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.config/opencode/freepi.key)" https://api.freepi.ai/me ``` ## Uninstall ```bash ./uninstall.sh ``` This removes the plugin, ad script, systemd service, and the `freepi` provider from `opencode.json`. Your API key is left in place (delete manually if desired). ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
